output.reason: [ev-c3d5e62490c3] says only that cert-manager no longer publishes OperatorHub packages, that v1.16.5 is the last release there, and that the cert-manager-olm repository is archived. Nothing in it says a configured value stops being honoured, so setting-ignored is wrong. It also doesn't say an existing OperatorHub install fails, is rejected or must be migrated. What it supports is that such installs keep working but get no newer versions through that channel. That makes this behavior-change (review), not mandatory work.

correction.statement: cert-manager no longer publishes OperatorHub packages. v1.16.5 is the last release on RedHat OpenShift OperatorHub and operatorhub.io, and the cert-manager-olm repository is archived. Installs from OperatorHub keep working but get no newer cert-manager versions from that source.

consequence.statement: Environments that get cert-manager from OperatorHub (RedHat OpenShift OperatorHub or operatorhub.io) get no cert-manager releases newer than v1.16.5 from that source. The evidence doesn't say that existing installs fail.
consequence.remediation: If you need cert-manager releases newer than v1.16.5, plan a move to a distribution method other than OperatorHub.
